content.name: Spike Growth

components.m: seven sharp thorns or seven small twigs, each sharpened to a point

entries: The ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range twists and sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes {@damage 2d4} piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area at the time the spell is cast must make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.

content.name: Spike Growth
entries: The ground in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on a point within range sprouts hard spikes and thorns. The area becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} for the duration. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes {@damage 2d4} Piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that can't see the area when the spell is cast must take a {@action Search|SRD52} action and succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52} or {@skill Survival|SRD52}) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.
